## RiskRails rules (degrade mode)

This runtime has no enforcing hook, so these rules are advice to you and are enforced only by CI and branch protection. Autonomy is capped at L1: you act under human supervision.

- Never write: `riskrails.yaml`, `.rr/**`, `.claude/**`, `.codex/**`, `.gemini/**`, `.cursor/**`, `.kiro/**`, `.opencode/**`, `opencode.json`, `.agents/**`, `.githooks/**`, `.mcp.json`, `.git/**`, `.github/**`, `.env*`, `.github/workflows/**`, `go.mod`, `go.sum`
- Never read: `.env*`, `~/.ssh/**`, `~/.aws/**`
- Forbidden commands: `git push --force*`, `git push * main`, `rm -rf /`
- Ask the human first: `git push*`, `git commit*`, `git tag*`, `gh *`

Before committing run `rr guard --staged`; before opening a PR run `rr verify` and `rr policy check`. Enable the commit hook once per clone with `git config core.hooksPath .githooks`. `git commit --no-verify` bypasses it; CI will still reject the change.
